name: Compassionate Drawcord
description: Hefts both nets at once and feels whether the azure pair hangs level from the hands.

name: Radiance Mesh
description: Snaps both wrists at once to send two nets out together on slightly different lines.

name: Vigor Billow
description: Flicks the bright rim of one net across the opponent's eyes while the other covers the thrower.

name: Commanding Sinker
description: Hauls the two nets inward like scissor blades until the opponent is pressed between the meshes.

name: Consecrated Weave
description: Crosses the taut cords before the chest to block a thrust on the knot where they meet.

name: Haulinboon
description: Slips sideways between two blows with a net swinging from each hand to cover the retreat.

name: Beguiling Hemcord
description: Lays the two nets overlapped on the ground so a single step between them springs both.

name: Destiny Meshgrid
description: Casts the first net to herd the foe then gathers both in one pull so they cannot rise.

name: Statute Leadedge
description: Draws both meshes shut with qi so the opponent's limbs and breath are held inside the pair.

name: Storied Solar Loopmesh
description: School technique that lowers both nets as one azure sheet whose strands clamp everything on the ground below.

name: Magnanimous Knotwork
description: Weighs the lead on the hem against the slope of the basin floor before the cast.

name: Thunderclap Smother
description: Throws a long net down one track and keeps a short net ready on the other.

name: Bedrock Haulin
description: Raps the leaded hem on the knee of an opponent climbing out over the basin edge.

name: Delugeweave
description: Crosses the long and short meshes at the moment of contact to turn a cut away.

name: Sigildrape
description: Hauls the long net down the slope so the netted opponent slides toward the thrower's feet.

name: Masterful Enmesh
description: Curls the near net round the opponent's ankle along the rim and jerks it out from under them.

name: Floatrope Odyssey
description: Slides along one track while recalling the other net so the thrower changes place without a gap.

name: Floatrope Reliquary
description: Spreads a hidden net over the basin floor that gathers up around anyone crossing it.

name: Season Knotwork
description: Passes the foe between the long net and the short net so neither ever loosens its hold.

name: Volition Spread
description: Presses the netted opponent into the basin floor with qi until they cannot lift a limb.

name: Masterful Leadedge
description: School technique that closes both tracks into a single bowl of mesh round everyone within the cast.

name: Sinkermercy
description: Checks that the folded wings of the net lie flat and will open without a snag.

name: Exalted Haulin
description: Spreads the net like pinion feathers in flight so it covers the opponent's whole upper body.

name: Quenched Loopmesh
description: Swings a weight on the wing tip against the opponent's collarbone in a short chopping blow.

name: Squall Enmesh
description: Beats the net like a wing to shove off the air and backstep out of reach.

name: Meshtroth
description: Beats the net open before the body in one stroke and stops a blow on the cords.

name: Billow Covenant
description: Dives after the cast and hauls the cord taut in the same movement to clamp the foe.

name: Entropy Mesh
description: Snatches a raised weapon with a looped cord and drags it out of the opponent's grip.

name: Thunderclap Weave
description: Uses a lift of qi to raise the net high before dropping it from above the foe.

name: Hooking Drawcord
description: Hangs a net in the branches with qi so it drops like a roosting hawk on a trigger.

name: Harmonious Drape
description: Throws the net wide then folds and throws again so the wingspan seems to beat twice.

name: Spreadtriumph
description: Drives hardened knots through the mesh like talons to pierce a padded guard.

name: Gallant Sinker Edict
description: School technique that spreads both wings overhead so their shadow falls and strands rain on all beneath.

name: Eclipse Meshgrid
description: Lets the wet rope slide through the palm to feel the current's drag along its length.

name: Royal Knotwork
description: Casts the net in one flowing motion from the shoulder so it opens low over the ground.

name: Unrivaled Drape
description: Slaps the hem across the opponent's hip with the quick whip of a bent reed.

name: Meshseal
description: Turns the net in a tight eddy beside the body so a thrust slides past.

name: Subjugating Smother
description: Hauls steadily with the current's rhythm and presses the netted foe to the ground.

name: Bedrock Leadedge
description: Weaves across rough ground in the light stepping of a ford crossing.

name: Guileful Drawcord
description: Lays a net under a shallow crossing so it rises round an opponent's legs mid-ford.

name: Season Loopmesh
description: Rolls cast and haul and release into one current that carries the foe where it pleases.

name: Season Floatrope
description: Slips along the net's own line in a flash to arrive on the far side of the foe.

name: Tyrannous Billow
description: School technique that draws the net closed with the unhurried pull of a river and locks the foe in place.

name: Pealweave
description: Spreads one qi field over both nets and reads their positions as if they were one hand.

name: Squall Weave
description: Throws both nets into the shared field so they open in step with each other.

name: Steel Drape
description: Lashes a hem through the field into the foe's side before the net itself arrives.

name: Stalwart Meshgrid
description: Sets both nets orbiting the body inside the field to catch whatever flies at the thrower.

name: Peremptory Smother
description: Hauls both cords through the field at once so the foe is pulled from two directions.

name: Weavevow
description: Stretches a field thread across the oncoming blade and lets the mesh slide it wide.

name: Windborne Enmesh
description: Steps through the field on a line anchored by both nets to stay at a safe distance.

name: Beguiling Mesh
description: Sets two nets in the field so that either one springs the other when disturbed.

name: Enmeshcrown
description: Hands the foe from one net to the other through the field in a seamless relay.

name: Volition Haulin
description: Closes both nets with the field so every limb is held and the foe's own qi is dulled.

name: Peremptory Retribution Billow
description: School technique that lays two tracks of field across the ground and shuts them over all who stand between.

name: Hemcord Blessing
description: Lets the warmth of the Core run down the cord and feels the whole net answer.

name: Pulsar Spread
description: Throws on a pulse from the Core so the net fans out flat and far.

name: Vigor Sinker
description: Fills the rim with Core strength and swings it down on the opponent's shoulder.

name: Vigor Meshgrid
description: Steps off a pulse of the Core and lands in the lee of the thrown net.

name: Clinging Enmesh
description: Runs a thread of Core qi through the mesh so it tightens with a steady heat.

name: Stately Drawcord
description: Orbits the net on the Core's rhythm to form a moving screen around the thrower.

name: Statute Mesh
description: Dives with the net and hauls with the Core's weight to drive the foe to the ground.

name: Pealsinker
description: Snaps the cord on a Core pulse so the netted foe is flung off line.

name: Sinkervow
description: Feeds the net with Core qi so it lies dormant and springs when stepped on.

name: Destiny Sinker
description: Chains cast and haul and recast on the Core's pulse so the foe never finds a break.

name: Radiance Spread
description: Drives the mesh forward on Core power so its hardened knots punch through plate and wood.

name: Imperious Knotwork
description: School technique that raises a canopy of Core-lit mesh and drops it over the whole field before the thrower.

name: Pealmesh
description: Breathes a sworn breath and weighs the net in time with it to find its balance.

name: Majestic Floatrope
description: Casts with the net's mouth turned to the wind so it fills and spreads as it flies.

name: Squall Hemcord
description: Swings the hem across the body in a sworn arc and cracks it against the opponent's guard.

name: Squall Loopmesh
description: Pushes off the rear foot like a gale gathering and steps back with the net trailing.

name: Masterful Smother
description: Tightens the oath cord with each breath so the net's grip grows with the thrower's patience.

name: Parityweave
description: Shears the open mesh across an incoming blade as a cutting wind shears a cloud.

name: Statute Hemcord
description: Rides a gust along the cord and hauls the snared foe along with its push.

name: Vigorspread
description: Slides a long pace across open ground with the net held flat behind like a sail.

name: Venommesh
description: Pegs a net low on the ground so a wind-sworn cord can lift it onto a passing foe.

name: Orchestral Weave
description: Links cast and drag and slide under the same sworn wind so each flows from the last.

name: Radiance Haulin
description: Draws a hardened mesh edge forward on a sworn gust to cut through leather and cloth guards.

name: Thrall Floatrope
description: School technique that swears the net to the wind so it closes on its target and will not let go.

name: Nurturing Leadedge
description: Takes the weight of the net in both hands and sets the feet on a firm plateau stance.

name: Thunderclap Spread
description: Casts the net straight along a taken bearing across the bare plain before the thrower.

name: Spreaddecree
description: Hits the opponent with the leaded hem as hard and flat as a stone dropped on rock.

name: Venerable Mesh
description: Braces the net upright on its bearing line to take the force of an oncoming rush.

name: Spreadseal
description: Draws the netted foe across the plateau in a straight haul along the bearing.

name: Feather Sinker
description: Pivots on the wind-side foot to keep the bearing while the net comes round.

name: Latchweave
description: Sets a net on a plateau bearing so anyone who crosses the line is caught.

name: Destiny Weave
description: Casts and recasts along the same bearing so the foe is netted wherever they run.

name: Destiny Haulin
description: Draws the net shut along the held bearing until every limb is sealed in the mesh.

name: Haulinbanner
description: School technique that drops the net from the plateau edge so it falls across the slope below.

name: Meshmercy
description: Tests the grip against a gust to learn how hard the net can pull before it tears free.

name: Haulinverdict
description: Throws the net to spread on the first gust so its edge falls beyond the opponent.

name: Bedrock Loopmesh
description: Whips a rim weight on the edge of a gale into the opponent's knee.

name: Delugesinker
description: Spins the cord and the mesh together in a whirl that sweeps a blade off its line.

name: Peremptory Spread
description: Heaves on the cord with the wind at the back to drag a netted opponent forward.

name: Authoritative Drape
description: Throws so the gale curls the net around the opponent's back and pins both arms.

name: Soundless Drape
description: Takes a long step with the gale behind and lands ready to throw again.

name: Parity Leadedge
description: Pegs several nets in a field so a rising gale lifts them together across the path.

name: Volition Billow
description: Rides one gale through throw and curl and haul so the whole pass takes a single breath.

name: Pulsar Knotwork
description: Flashes forward on the gale's leading edge to reach the foe as the net comes down.

name: Authoritative Drawcord Reliquary
description: School technique that swears the net to the gale so it carries over a foe and binds every limb.

name: Wise Mesh
description: Feels the cord hum in the open wind of the plateau to learn how it will fly.

name: Radiance Hemcord
description: Throws wide with the full arm so the net opens broad over the open ground.

name: Squallhaulin
description: Swings the open rim weights round the body into the side of the foe.

name: Deluge Billow
description: Shifts the stride across the open plateau so the net stays between the thrower and the foe.

name: Staunch Knotwork
description: Braces the net before the body as a sworn guard against a charge.

name: Millstone Enmesh
description: Hauls and presses the netted foe flat against the open ground with steady qi.

name: Venom Drawcord
description: Flicks the mesh into a plateau gust so it snaps around the foe's weapon arm.

name: Veering Hemcord
description: Retreats along the sworn line in measured steps so the cord stays clear.

name: Sinkertroth
description: Hides a net in the grass of the open plateau so it leaps up on a passing foe.

name: Volition Smother
description: Passes the foe from cast to haul to press along one sworn line without a gap.

name: Gloommesh
description: Roots the net on the plateau with the weight of the oath so the foe cannot rise.

name: Splendid Bedrock Sinker
description: School technique that fills the open air with falling net strands that pin all within the sworn ground.

name: Nurturing Meshgrid
description: Spreads the qi field and tastes the gale through it to know the wind before it arrives.

name: Radiance Loopmesh
description: Casts the net into the field so the gale catches it and carries it to the mark.

name: Heroic Enmesh
description: Lashes the rim through the field into the opponent's flank before the net lands.

name: Sinkerseal
description: Orbits the net in the field on the gale's rhythm as a screen against missiles.

name: Sigilspread
description: Hauls the field-borne net from afar so the foe is dragged along the gale's line.

name: Drapeboon
description: Steps along a bearing marked in the field so the cord never crosses itself.

name: Sigilweave
description: Sets the net in the field so the gale springs it when a step breaks the marked line.

name: Choral Drape
description: Hands the foe along the field from cast to haul to cinch on the gale's pulse.

name: Ruling Smother
description: Seals the netted foe with field strands that the gale keeps drawn tight.

name: Unbending Floatrope
description: School technique that lets the gale close a field of net over every foe in the thrower's sight.

name: Serene Leadedge
description: Reads the weight of the net through the Core and finds the bearing that steadies it.

name: Squalldrape
description: Throws on a pulse from the Core into the gale so the net travels far and flat.

name: Quenched Spread
description: Raps the rim against the foe with the Core's weight and the gale's push behind it.

name: Haulinpledge
description: Pulls the cord with Core strength along the sworn line so the mesh tightens at once.

name: Pall Weave
description: Meets a blade with the Core-stiffened mesh and lets the wind carry the cut away.

name: Volition Meshgrid
description: Hauls the netted foe along the held bearing with the Core bearing the load.

name: Ethereal Enmesh
description: Steps on a Core pulse into the gust and arrives at the net's far side.

name: Sigilsinker
description: Sets a net on a bearing with Core qi so it springs from the plateau grass on a crossing foe.

name: Tenet Spread
description: Chains cast and cinch and haul on one sworn bearing with the Core carrying each link.

name: Sinker Banner
description: Drives the net forward on a Core burst and a gale so its knots pierce a shielded guard.

name: Vaunted Mesh
description: School technique that holds the sworn bearing and lets a Core-driven gale drop the net over the field.
